title: Insignia — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Insignia.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Smart Home Value." Value tier. Insignia is Best Buys private-label brand — covering appliances, electronics, and accessories at the lowest possible prices. Appliances are manufactured by various OEMs to Best Buy specifications. The absolute entry point for appliance purchases.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Extreme budget buyers shopping Best Buy. Dorm rooms, starter apartments, secondary appliances.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Insignia:

• Lowest price appliances at Best Buy

• Best Buy warranty and return policy backing

• Basic functionality at unbeatable prices

• Wide availability at every Best Buy location

• Good enough for secondary or temporary needs
